queries: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean, p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg ORDER BY p.event_name

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines are inner-joined to events, so lines without a matching event are dropped; events are grouped by event_name, so events sharing a name are pooled into one average over their budget lines.
Event names whose amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the mean of averages; each remaining name counts once.

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines are inner-joined to event on link_to_event = event_id, so lines with no matching event are dropped. Lines are grouped by event_name, so events that share a name are pooled into one average.
Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have a NULL average. They are left out of the mean of averages and cannot be above it.
